undelivered_timer_events.description: A finished timer was dismissed, but the hub could not confirm the satellite stopped ringing: the stop message could not be delivered. The satellite may still be ringing. The hub keeps retrying the stop and clears this warning after three consecutive stop attempts reach the satellite again — usually within about 46 minutes after the satellite is reachable again, but a failed stop attempt restarts the wait, so one failed attempt can push it to about 91 minutes, and if the satellite keeps failing or keeps going unavailable it may not clear until the record expires after 24 hours. Reaching the satellite only means it answered — it does not prove the stop arrived — so if the satellite is still ringing, dismiss the timer again.
undelivered_timer_events.title: A dismissed timer may still be ringing

data.q11_ring_timing: Timer finished while the system was down

init.description: Pick the voice satellites whose timers should appear as sensors. The primary satellite is the one a dashboard timer rings when no satellite is named; leave it unset with a single satellite. A timer that finished while the system was down never rings — it is shown, not announced — and a stopped alarm is never re-rung. Satellite alarm behaviour stays 'Not yet measured' until the listen test measures what the satellite firmware does when a timer finishes.
init.title: Satellite Timers
